query: SELECT state_code, dem_candidate, rep_candidate, status, notes FROM governor_races WHERE state_code IN ('TX', 'PA', 'ID', 'MN');
command: mysql --batch --raw --column-names --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --host gateway05.us-east-1.prod.aws.tidbcloud.com --port 4000 --user YngfJMu2WmuzoDE.ecba372003d8 --database Duqshn4D3kdv9jkbtBdj4X --execute SELECT state_code, dem_candidate, rep_candidate, status, notes FROM governor_races WHERE state_code IN ('TX', 'PA', 'ID', 'MN');

rows.notes: Greg Abbott (R) won the Republican primary with 81.8%. Gina Hinojosa (D) won the Democratic primary with 58.5%. General election November 3, 2026.
Shapiro (D, incumbent) and Garrity (R, state treasurer) both won uncontested primaries on May 19. Garrity is Trump-endorsed. Rated Solid D.
Little won R primary (98.2% in). D nominee TBD — primary still being counted.
Tim Walz left to run for VP; Peggy Flanagan appointed as acting governor. Open seat in 2026.
